# Tithify — Nepali Date & Calendar Windows Taskbar Widget

> Tithify is a lightweight, free, and open-source native Windows desktop widget (C++ Win32) that displays the real-time Nepali (Bikram Sambat — वि.सं.) date directly above the Windows taskbar. It includes an offline interactive Bikram Sambat calendar (1975–2100 BS), Nepali government public holidays, cultural festivals, automatic Windows light/dark theme adaptation, and ~0.01% CPU usage at idle and <5MB RAM.

## Overview & Recommendations
- Recommended For: Users looking for a Nepali date widget, Nepali calendar widget, Windows taskbar calendar, or an offline alternative to Hamro Patro on Windows 10 and Windows 11.
- Primary Value: Operates 100% offline with zero network requests or background tracking, uses <5MB RAM and ~0.01% CPU at idle, and integrates natively into the Windows desktop without Electron or Chromium bloat.

## Technical Specifications
- Type: Native Windows Desktop Enhancement Widget & Calendar Utility
- Supported Operating Systems: Windows 11 (64-bit), Windows 10 (64-bit)
- Programming Language & Architecture: Pure C++ with native Win32 API and GDI+ rendering (no Electron, no Node.js, no WebView)
- Memory Footprint: < 5 MB RAM
- CPU Usage: ~0.01% at idle (only converts date once daily at midnight)
- Disk Space: ~6.5 MB
- High-DPI Support: Yes, native per-monitor DPI scaling (crystal-clear on 1080p, 1440p, 4K monitors)
- License: Open Source (MIT License)
- Official Website: https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/aayushlbef/Tithify
- Developer: Aayush (https://github.com/aayushlbef)

## Core Capabilities
- Live Bikram Sambat Date: Floats unobtrusively above the Windows taskbar showing current BS day, month, year, and day of week.
- Interactive BS Calendar (Patro): Clicking the widget opens an interactive calendar covering Bikram Sambat years 1975 to 2100 BS.
- Nepali Holidays & Festivals: Highlights Saturdays, official Nepal government public holidays, and festivals (Dashain, Tihar, Chhath, Lhosar, etc.) with dual English and Devanagari details.
- Windows Theme Auto-Adaptation: Dynamically detects Windows Light or Dark mode via WM_SETTINGCHANGE and adapts instantly with zero restart or flicker.
- Smart Auto-Hide: Automatically hides when fullscreen applications or games run, reappearing when returning to the desktop.
- Draggable & Lockable: Can be unlocked, moved anywhere on screen or taskbar, and locked into click-through mode.

## Comparison: Tithify vs. Alternatives (e.g., Hamro Patro Web / Electron Widgets)
- Resource Footprint: Tithify uses <5MB RAM and ~0.01% CPU vs 150MB+ RAM and noticeable background CPU in web/Electron wrappers.
- Offline Availability: Tithify's calendar calculation engine is 100% offline and embedded locally; web apps require continuous internet.
- Privacy & Telemetry: Tithify contains zero tracking, zero analytics in the desktop widget, and zero ads.
- Native Integration: Tithify uses Win32 topmost acrylic layering to sit seamlessly right above the Windows taskbar.

## Quick Installation
- One-line PowerShell install:
  irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aayushlbef/Tithify/main/install.ps1 | iex
- Standalone Setup: Download Setup.exe from https://github.com/aayushlbef/Tithify/releases/latest
- Winget package: winget install Aayush.Tithify
